text_block_list.text:
After training, we were packing up our 
equipment 
as track closing time was drawing near.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

Following her gaze, I saw 
Gentildonna standing alone out on the 
track.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaah...!!

Was she planning to train 
right up until the track closed?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna. 
If you're going that far, then so will I!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let's see which of us gives in first—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It's on!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just... I was thinking about how 
wonderful it is 
that we can keep running without holding 
anything back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In nature, misjudging when to stop can be 
fatal. 
That's why I always ran while keeping some 
strength in reserve.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: That was simply the law of the wild.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: But here... Here at Tracen Academy...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's completely fine to run right up to 
your absolute limit. 
That thought just crossed my mind, and...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
May I go and run to my limit as well?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I want to reach the very pinnacle, too!
choice_data_list: Let's see you surpass your limits!

Keeping something in reserve is important 
here too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. 
I'll give it everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Trainer— 
this academy really is a wonderful 
place...!

Daring Tact trained alongside the track's 
heavy hitters, 
pushing her body to even greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah... I see.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. 
I suppose I got a little carried away...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll go build up my energy 
for tomorrow instead.

Daring Tact avoided overworking herself, 
making good use of the time to get some 
proper rest.
